name: Abib
overview: The month of Abib, also known as Nisan, is significant in the biblical calendar as the first month of the year, marking the beginning of God's appointed times for Israel (Exodus 12:2). It is the month in which the LORD instituted the Passover and delivered the Israelites from Egypt, a foundational event commemorated annually (Exodus 23:15; Deuteronomy 16:1). Additionally, Abib is associated with key moments in Israel's journey, including the setting up of the tabernacle (Exodus 40:2,17) and their arrival at the wilderness of Zin (Numbers 20:1), underscoring its importance in God's redemptive plan and covenant relationship with His people.
